# rustfs_iam_backup Data Source

Export all RustFS IAM entities (users, groups, policies, service accounts) as a base64-encoded ZIP archive

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rustfs_iam_backup" "export" {}

output "iam_backup_base64" {
  value     = data.rustfs_iam_backup.export.content_base64
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded ZIP archive containing all IAM data.
